cases.name: invalid/date-function
cases.query: SELECT date(created_at, 'unixepoch') FROM events

cases.name: invalid/random
cases.query: SELECT random()

cases.name: invalid/iif
cases.query: SELECT iif(TRUE, 1, 2)

cases.name: invalid/comment
cases.query: SELECT 1 -- comment

cases.name: invalid/block-comment
cases.query: SELECT /* c */ 1

cases.name: invalid/two-statements
cases.query: SELECT 1; SELECT 2

cases.name: invalid/insert
cases.query: INSERT INTO events (id) VALUES ('x')

cases.name: invalid/pragma
cases.query: PRAGMA table_info(events)

cases.name: invalid/values
cases.query: VALUES (1)

cases.name: invalid/collate
cases.query: SELECT content FROM events ORDER BY content COLLATE NOCASE

cases.name: invalid/blob-literal
cases.query: SELECT X'00'

cases.name: invalid/hex-literal
cases.query: SELECT 0x10

cases.name: invalid/bitwise-operator
cases.query: SELECT 1 & 2
